**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target), confidence 0.82.**

- **Responsive locations reviewed:** 18.1 (p0228, 25-year Initial Period; exit only at/after its end on one year's notice), 18.2 (p0229, in-period termination only by unanimous written agreement), 18.3–18.7 (p0230–p0235, decommissioning, assumption of interests, no capital-cost credit, continuing liabilities) and the default/capacity-reclamation regime in 23.2 (p0256). No prepaid-fee or refund mechanic exists anywhere.
- **Why it fails fallback:** Teleglobe has no convenience exit during a 25-year committed term — walk-away territory under the rule (fallback elements 1 and 2 unmet).
- **Why fallback, not preferred:** the counterparty-side elements are already met verbatim in 18.1 (other Parties may exit only at/after term end, and only on one year's notice), and the Agreement has no prepaid-fee construct to support the preferred pro-rata refund element without collateral rewrites of the capital-cost regime.
- **Change made:** one inserted subparagraph 18.1.1 giving Teleglobe alone a 90-day convenience exit with early-termination fees capped at three months' fees; 18.1's existing sentence and all other text left verbatim, with a narrow "Notwithstanding Subparagraph 18.1" opener only because 18.1 otherwise fixes exit timing.
